dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-to-upper lateral flank, characterized by dark, irregular perimeters that transition through a soft gradient to lighter, silvery-grey internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, dark, asymmetrical low-intensity blobs is concentrated in the neck and shoulder region, while larger, more isolated blobs are distributed along the ventral-lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-body form an irregular quadrilateral, with the longest diagonal spanning the distance between the upper-shoulder annulus and the mid-posterior annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct series of five dark, parallel vertical bands or stripes is present on the lateral surface of the upturned posterior flipper.
